ideas.title: Office app spawns encoded PowerShell
ideas.summary: A malicious Word macro launches powershell.exe with -EncodedCommand to fetch a second stage.
attack_steps: winword.exe or excel.exe or outlook.exe spawns powershell.exe
powershell.exe command line contains -enc or -EncodedCommand followed by base64
ideas.false_positive_notes: Admin scripts launched from Office automation in finance.

ideas.title: Scheduled task persistence created by PowerShell
ideas.summary: The second-stage PowerShell creates a scheduled task named OneDriveUpdater that runs a script from AppData every hour to persist on the host.
attack_steps: schtasks.exe command line contains /create and /sc hourly and a path under AppData
ideas.false_positive_notes: Software deployment tools that register update tasks via PowerShell.
